meanings: the use of irony to mock or convey contempt
mnemonic: sarc-(肉/撕裂) + -asm(名詞) = 說話如同撕裂皮肉般尖酸刺人 -> 諷刺挖苦

examples.en: Chandler is famous for his trademark witty sarcasm.
examples.zh: 錢德勒以其標誌性機智幽默的諷刺著稱。

meanings: susceptible to physical or emotional attack or harm
mnemonic: vulner(傷口) + -able(能夠) = 容易被刺破產生傷口的 -> 脆弱的

examples.en: Being truly vulnerable allows for authentic connection.
examples.zh: 展現真實的脆弱才能產生真摯的心理連結。

meanings: delay or postpone action; put off doing something
mnemonic: pro-(向前推) + crastin(明天) + -ate(使動) = 一直把事情推到明天才做 -> 拖延

examples.en: Do not procrastinate on your study goals until the weekend.
examples.zh: 別把學習目標一直拖延到週末才做。

meanings: able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions
meaningsZh: 具韌性的、能迅速復原的
mnemonic: re-(向後反彈) + sili(跳躍) + -ent(形容詞) = 遭遇打擊後能迅速彈跳復原 -> 具韌性的

examples.en: Spider-Man proved to be remarkably resilient after every defeat.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛人在每一次挫敗後都展現出驚人的心理韌性。

meanings: performed or occurring as a result of a sudden inner impulse without premeditation
meaningsZh: 自發的、隨興自然的、一時興起的
mnemonic: spont-(自願/內心動機) + -eous(形容詞) = 順從內心當下直覺而行 -> 隨興自然的

examples.en: They took a spontaneous weekend road trip to the coast.
examples.zh: 他們一時興起，展開了一趟開往海邊的週末公路旅行。
